geometry.rule: Upper ring: z>0.05 m; mid plane: |z|<0.01 m; lower: z<-0.02 m. Nested 8-coil set drops the unique lower coil and the mid-plane coil closest to the z-axis. Nested 6-coil set additionally drops remaining mid-plane coils. Alternate 8-coil set drops the two upper-ring coils with largest |x|.
